title: Reduced Graph Rank-Order Conjecture at Rank 10
formal_target: Find a reduced simple graph of order at least 63 and real adjacency rank exactly 10, or prove the 62-vertex bound for a precisely specified nontrivial infinite class.
current_claim: No order-at-least-63 counterexample is known. Exact independently implemented certificates prove the sharp 62-vertex upper bound for every reduced rank-10 graph containing a connected nonsingular induced ten-vertex core with at most eleven edges: tree, unicyclic, or bicyclic. The current seven-page sparse-core manuscript combines those three audited theorems. Cores with at least twelve edges, and hence the full rank-10 conjecture, remain open.
next_exact_frontier: The tree, unicyclic and bicyclic milestones are frozen and independently audited. The user-authorized terminal result is the sharp sparse-core structural theorem. If the unrestricted project is explicitly resumed, enumerate connected tricyclic ten-vertex cores by two independent canonical routes and apply the same exact profile-compatibility target-53 gate.
pdf_policy: The seven-page combined sparse-core partial theorem is the single current submission-ready replacement. Do not create additional versions unless the mathematical theorem or author metadata changes and a new independent submission audit passes.
